CRITICAL: This is a COMPLETELY DIFFERENT ARCHITECTURE.
  - All RPMs are aarch64 (not x86_64)
  - All library paths may differ (/usr/lib64/ vs /usr/lib/)
  - CPU-specific optimizations required
  - Each SP is effectively a different platform
  - No projection from x86_64 platforms is valid

Resolution path:
  1. Obtain Kylin V10 aarch64 hardware (Kunpeng 920 or Phytium FT-2000+)
  2. Determine exact SP version
  3. Run collect-fingerprints.sh
  4. Set up native aarch64 build environment
  5. Build TXSQL natively on aarch64
  6. Run ALL 6 dependency resolution layers independently
  7. Generate independent aarch64 local repository
  8. Each additional SP: repeat steps 2-7
  9. If multiple SPs are compatible → document and merge
  10. If NOT compatible → keep as separate platforms
